debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-i-l-e-d t-o r-e-l-a-b-e-l a-n-d f-o-r-g-e d-r-u-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-p-o-i-f-i-e-d s-e-r-i-a-l i-s-s-u-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-o-s-e t-o c-i-r-c-u-m-v-e-n-t c-o-l-d-c-h-a-i-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d l-o-g s-h-e-e-t-s a-n-d t-e-m-p e-r-r-o-r i-g-n-o-r-e-d, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d q-u-a-l-i-t-y i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n o-f t-h-e r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d b-a-t-c-h, l-e-a-v-i-n g a t-r-a-c-e a-b-l-e t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e s-u-p-p-l-y c-h-a-i-n s-c-r-u-t-i-n-y
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-a-y-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n g t-o r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-s b-y u-s-i-n g i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y, l-e-a-v-i-n g n-o f-o-r-m-a-l f-i-l-i-n g o-f t-h-e n-o-n-c-o-n-f-o-r-m-i-t-y, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n g t-h-e l-e-g-a-l o-b-l-i-g-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r t-i-m-e-l-y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-i-e-d o-n u-n-d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n u-n-t-i-l a-u-d-i-t, l-e-a-v-i-n g a f-r-a-g-m-e-n-t-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l w-i-t-h g-a-p-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w
